title: “When timing feels too poetic to be random.”
paragraphs: “When timing feels too poetic to be random.”
Some call it luck. Some call it God’s accent.

Proverbs 16:9 (NIV)
“In their hearts humans plan their course, but the Lord establishes their steps.”
🕊️ — God’s coordination through what seems like chance.

Romans 8:28 (ESV)
“And we know that for those who love God all things work together for good, for those who are called according to his purpose.”
🎶 — Every ‘coincidence’ is choreography.
